payload.text: Client names and Intent's committed record. hv ruled on 2026-11-10 that a client's name is confidential in Intent's public record (decision 117). vc keeps a client's name and its sessions' names out of every commit message, board text and thread, and banks client-named notes only as local refs. The one unpushed message that names client sessions, c1d7d163d's, is rewritten by hv before the push (hold 8). STILL OPEN, for hv alone: upstream already carries the first word of the name in 10 tracked files (eight event files of 2026-10-14 to 16, and cc's and vc's board.json) and in 3 pushed commit messages; cleaning that means rewriting public history and a force push to every remote.
